in_arabic.name: Lamiah
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني A gentle and tender mother
in_arabic.long_meaning: Lamiah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'L-M-H', meaning 'to soften', 'to be gentle', or 'to care for'. This name is a beautiful reminder of the tenderness and nurturing nature of Allah (swt) towards His creation, especially mothers who embody this quality.
